title: January-started university senior-staff stoppage reported as suspended during February

start_date.summary: Reports place the start in January but conflict between Jan. 2 and Jan. 21; only month precision is retained.

end_date.summary: Reports describe a suspension and return-to-work call by Feb. 10; the physical cessation date is not established in the available search-only material.

public_assembly.summary: These reports describe an industrial stoppage, injunction and workplace impact, not a distinct public gathering during February.

notes: Cross-month labor dispute link only; no February crowd candidate is inferred. Start-day conflict remains open. January candidate GHA202101-E005 retains ownership unless review finds a separate February public action.
